footerNote: If your address can't be matched, we fall back to ZIP code. ZIP codes can cross district lines, so double-check yours on your voter page.

notes.title: Bring a photo ID.
notes.text: Texas asks for one of seven kinds of photo ID at the polls, like a Texas driver's license or a U.S. passport. If you don't have one and can't reasonably get one, you can still vote: you'll sign a form at the polls saying why, and show a document like a utility bill or bank statement.

notes.title: New U.S. House districts this year.
notes.text: Texas redrew its U.S. House districts for 2026, so your district number may have changed. The address lookup uses the new lines.
